content: CSV import failure handling: modern best practice is partial/row-level import (persist valid rows, skip and report invalid rows with actionable per-row error messages) rather than legacy all-or-nothing rejection on first bad row. Some vendors (e.g. Airtable) still reject the whole file on structural issues like blank rows, but per-row skip-with-report is considered the better UX for spreadsheet-shaped tools, since it doesn't block progress over a handful of bad rows in a large sheet.
